dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Actually, who came up with this game anyway? With the amount of calculations that you have to do every game... Don't tell me it was one of those Rtawahist kids?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Oh, you're leaving? You youngsters sure have a lot of energy. Go on, then. I'd like to stay here a little longer.

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: I had this match figured out as soon as I laid my eyes on the cards. A pretty simple calculation, really.

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Well played. I can see that you've put a lot of thought into this game. Got any interest in turning your insights into a paper? As a senior scholar, I can give you some guidance on the writing process.

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Alright, we can play a round. It's been a while since I hung out with you youngsters.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me adjust my deck first...

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Seems like I haven't completely fallen behind the times.

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Hmph, seems these modern games have become nothing but overly-complicated...

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Sure, I just happen to be taking a walk to clear my head. Those ancient texts were making me all dizzy... so a game should be a nice change of pace.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me adjust my deck first...

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Phew... I feel a lot better now. If you still want to play a few more rounds, just say the word.

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: *sigh* These cards are so varied and colorful, my eyes are getting sore just keeping track of them all. Do you have any tea? I could use some to help me concentrate.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...
